tip.scale: Changes the size of the whole SKYCORE interface. Auto follows Minecraft's GUI scale.
tip.glow: Adjusts the soft glow around the main window. 0 turns it off.
tip.radius: How rounded corners are on cards, buttons and fields.
tip.opacity: How opaque the SKYCORE window is. Lower values let more of the world show through.
tip.dim: Darkens the game behind SKYCORE so the interface is easier to read.
tip.borders: Draws thin outlines around cards and panels.
tip.gradients: Uses subtle vertical gradients on surfaces and progress bars.
tip.hover: Lightens cards and rows under the cursor.

tip.reduce_motion: Turns off animations and transitions everywhere in SKYCORE.
tip.anim_intensity: Speed of transitions: lower is snappier, higher is slower and smoother.

tip.hud_opacity: How opaque the widget background is.
tip.hud_theme_accent: Use the current theme's accent color for this widget.

settings.rescan_done_body: Sidebar and tab list were read again. Open a menu to sync exact XP.
settings.confirm_history: Delete the event log, correction log and snapshots? Your current levels, runs and goals are kept.
settings.fair_play: SKYCORE only reads what the game already shows you. It never sends input, opens menus, clicks, or uses the Hypixel API.

health.title: Source health

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.desc: Which SkyBlock profile data is written to
profiles.identified_desc: Progress is written to this profile only. Profiles of different Minecraft accounts are kept apart even if they share a name.
profiles.unknown_desc: SKYCORE waits for the game to show your profile (chat or tab list) before writing profile data. Messages from the last two minutes are kept and applied once it is confirmed.
profiles.confirm_tip: Only use this if you are sure – SKYCORE will write data to the selected profile.
profiles.confirm_delete: Delete all stored data of profile "{0}"? A safety backup is created first, so it can be restored.
profile.state.confirmed.tip: The game confirmed this profile. Click to manage profiles.
profile.state.unknown.tip: Profile data is paused until the game shows which profile you are on. Click for details.
profile.state.sample.tip: Sample data is shown. Your real data is not changed.
status.offline.tip: Not on Hypixel SkyBlock. Click to manage profiles.
backup.title: Backups & recovery
backup.desc: Automatic backups, restore, import and crash recovery
backup.interrupted_tip: The game did not shut down cleanly (crash or forced close). Everything saved until the time shown was kept. Nothing was estimated for the gap.
backup.now_tip: Writes a full, checksummed backup of all data. Manual backups are never deleted automatically.
backup.export_stats_tip: Writes your statistics as JSON plus CSV tables (levels, runs, sessions) to config/skycore/exports. No account names or chat.
backup.policy: Automatic backups are made daily and every 6 hours of play. A safety backup is made before every reset, delete, repair, restore and import. Damaged backups are never restored, and the newest valid backup is never deleted.
backup.safety_failed_body: The safety backup could not be written, so nothing was changed.
backup.safety_note: A safety backup is created first, so this can be restored.
backup.plan.add: New profile {0} – will be added ({1} runs)
backup.plan.separate: {0} belongs to a different account – will be added separately
backup.plan.goals_events: Goals: {0} new · History events: {1} new, {2} duplicates
backup.merge_vs_restore: Merge only adds what is missing and never overwrites your current values. Restore replaces everything with the backup (after a safety backup).
backup.merge_tip: Adds missing profiles, runs, sessions, goals and history. Current values always win.
backup.restore_tip: Replaces all current data and settings with this backup. A safety backup is made first.
backup.merged_body: {0} items added. A safety backup was created first.
backup.refused: The file failed validation or the safety backup could not be written – nothing was changed.
integrity.title: Data integrity
integrity.desc: Checks stored data for duplicates, impossible values and conflicts
integrity.repairable: Can be repaired safely (logged, after a backup).
integrity.not_repairable: Left unchanged – the next verified reading from the game will settle it.
integrity.repair_tip: Fixes only provably invalid values (impossible numbers, exact duplicates). Every change is logged; a safety backup is made first.
integrity.policy: Nothing is deleted silently and nothing is invented. Suspicious but possible values are only reported.
integrity.confirm_repair: Repair all safely repairable problems? Each change is written to the repair log and a safety backup is created first.
integrity.d.no_profile_data: The active profile has no stored data
integrity.d.level_above_max: Level {0} is above the maximum of {1}
integrity.d.xp_exceeds: XP {0} exceeds the {1} needed for the next level
integrity.d.bad_gains: {0} gains are empty, zero or negative
integrity.d.dup_gains: {0} gains recorded twice at the same moment
integrity.d.completions_low: Completion counter {0} is lower than the {1} stored runs
integrity.d.unknown_profile_events: {0} events refer to profiles that are no longer stored
integrity.d.session_over: {0} 10-minute blocks contain more than 10 minutes of playtime
integrity.d.session_invalid: {0} session blocks contain negative or invalid values
patterns.title: Recognition patterns
patterns.desc: Built-in rules and your own patterns.json
patterns.json_invalid: patterns.json is not valid JSON – your previous patterns stay active.
patterns.disabled_runtime: switched off: too expensive to evaluate
patterns.none: No custom patterns. Copy patterns.example.json to patterns.json to add some.
patterns.help: patterns.json is reloaded automatically when it changes. Each pattern is checked before it becomes active: required named groups, a known kind, a confidence between 0 and 1, and regex safety (no nested quantifiers or back-references, bounded evaluation cost). Built-in rules are never replaced.
debug.title: Live debugger
debug.desc: See how messages are recognized (off by default)
debug.enable_desc: Keeps the last 250 recognition decisions in memory only
debug.privacy: The debugger never stores chat text. Unrecognized lines are kept only as length and an anonymous hash; player chat is only counted. Turning it off discards everything.
debug.empty: Nothing recorded yet for this filter.
debug.counts: {0} entries · {1} unrecognized lines · {2} player messages ignored
debug.export_tip: Writes health, pattern, database and integrity status plus debugger entries to config/skycore/diagnostics. Profile names are replaced by aliases; no player names, UUIDs, chat or server addresses.
debug.reason.profile_unknown_held: held until the profile is confirmed
debug.reason.profile_unknown_expired: dropped – profile not confirmed in time
debug.reason.reconciled: verified value differed – corrected and logged

mayor.unknown_tip: Open the Calendar or the Mayor menu yourself once per SkyBlock year – SKYCORE reads the active mayor and perks from it. Until then no bonus is applied.

floors.title: Floors
floors.level_unknown: Catacombs level unknown – open the Catacombs menu to read it.
floors.unclassified: {0} completed runs could not be assigned to a floor and are not counted – click a run to correct it.
floors.note: Normal and Master Mode floors are tracked separately. ≈ = approximate.
floors.tip_lifetime: {0} runs ({1} with XP) · {2} XP in total
floors.tip_xph_none: XP per hour needs 3 timed runs

floors.run_unclassified: Floor could not be determined – not counted

sessions.tracking_tip: New playtime and XP are recorded for this confirmed profile only.
sessions.paused_tip: Playtime is held for up to two minutes until the profile is confirmed, otherwise stored as unassigned – never given to a guessed profile.
sessions.no_history: No sessions recorded for this profile yet.
assign.title: Assign unassigned data
assign.desc: Data recorded before the profile could be identified is kept separately. Assign it to the profile it belongs to – nothing is moved automatically.
assign.no_target: No identified profile yet – join SkyBlock first.
assign.rules: Timestamps, XP, event ids, confidence and sources stay unchanged. A safety backup is made first, the merge is checked before it is saved, and the change is written to the correction log.
assign.failed_body: The assignment did not pass validation or the safety backup failed.
health.unresolved_tip: Completed slayer quests and dungeon runs whose exact tier or floor is not confirmed yet. They are resolved automatically when reliable evidence arrives, or you can correct them in Progression.
debug.reason.late_conflict: late evidence contradicts the record – kept unchanged
debug.reason.reconcile_conflict: counters contradict the records – nothing changed

calibrate.unavailable: SKYCORE has no definition for this stat, so it cannot be calibrated. Nothing was changed.
error.page_failed: This page could not be drawn. Details are in the game log. Switch pages or reopen SKYCORE.
share.section.general_desc: SKYCORE prepares messages, you decide what to send
share.enabled_desc: Turn this off to stop preparing any messages
share.toast: Show a small notification when a message is ready
share.manual_note: SKYCORE never sends messages, presses keys or writes to chat. It prepares the text and copies it only when you click Copy or press the Copy key. Pasting and sending is always up to you.
share.section.inbox_desc: Newest first. Copy one, paste it in chat and press Enter yourself
share.inbox_empty: Nothing prepared yet. Messages appear here when you reach a milestone.
share.report_sample: Not available while sample data is shown.
share.report_none: No stat with a known level yet.
share.report_failed: Not enough verified data for a report.
share.section.routing_desc: Which achievements are prepared, and where they are meant to go
share.rules_desc: A rule overrides the destination of its category, optionally only for one stat. The first matching rule wins.
share.section.milestones_desc: Only these levels are announced. Remove a value to skip it
share.ms.major_slayer: Slayer tier counts as major from
share.ms.skill_max_desc: Only the real maximum of a skill, never smaller levels
share.section.checkpoints_desc: Uses the target of each of your Goals
share.cp.nearly_desc: Before a milestone level, using the run thresholds of the Notifications page
share.cp.note: Each checkpoint fires once per goal. A goal that already passed a checkpoint when it is first seen does not announce it afterwards. Completion of a goal is announced once.
share.section.templates_desc: Write your own wording. Several variations keep messages from sounding the same
share.placeholders: Placeholders: {0}. A sentence with a value that is not available is left out instead of showing a gap. Estimated values are written with a leading ~.
share.preview_empty: Nothing left to show: every sentence needs a missing value
share.preview_note: Example values, not your data. The signature is shown for categories where it is enabled.
share.section.signature_desc: Optional text added to messages. Switch it on per category under routing
share.sig_note: SKYCORE is an independent mod and is not affiliated with Hypixel. Keep that in mind when you choose the wording.
share.autocopy_desc: Off by default. When on, each prepared message replaces what is on your clipboard.
share.clipboard_note: With auto-copy off, your clipboard is only changed when you click Copy or press the Copy key (set it under Controls).
share.section.community_desc: Optional: prepare a reply when someone asks for SKYCORE in party chat
share.com.enabled_desc: Only the exact message !skycore in Party chat from another player. Nothing is sent automatically.
share.com.status_off: Inactive: the feature is switched off
share.com.status_nourl: Inactive until you enter an installation link
share.com.status_badurl: Inactive: the link must start with http:// or https:// and contain no spaces
share.com.status_on: Active: a reply is prepared when someone asks
share.com.note: SKYCORE has no link of its own. It only uses the one you enter, never opens it, and never replies by itself.
